labels.RISK_REVIEW: Material adverse content supported by primary or independent corroborating evidence; route to a human reviewer.
labels.NON_TARGET: Supported positive, neutral, or otherwise non-material-adverse content; retain in the full-polarity ledger.
labels.ABSTAIN: Discovery-only, conflicted, insufficient, unclear, or axis-incoherent content.

source_lane_policy.P0: evidence-ready or evidence-required lane only; authority never supplies the target label
source_lane_policy.P1: issuer-context lane; authority never supplies the target label
source_lane_policy.P2_or_lower: discovery-only lane and ABSTAIN until evidence is upgraded

freeze_rules: validate every row before assigning a split
hold out complete sources where feasible
exclude all exact and near-duplicate v1 blind and training texts
hash and freeze text plus labels before the candidate sees blind-v2
deployment_boundary: This contract and its audit do not promote or replace the deployed shadow v1 router.
